{{Top|leg}}
The '''TGM Hospital''' was located in [[Grig]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was exclusively for the use of [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] employees. As a major storehouse for medicines, it was guarded by officers from the [[Imperial Substance Control Authority]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
